# MacOS dot files

This is my actual dotfiles that I use all day long for all kind of stuff, for working and for personal projects. I've decided to make everything install manually because I don't like to use another software to install my default configuration. All of this configuration is main focused on macOS, but could be adapted for another uses, like linux (but I think nothing of this will makes sense on Windows, sorry). Feel free to explore all my configuration and get what you feel makes sense to you! :^)

<img width="1450" alt="image" src="gruvboxKing.png">

## Apps added

- [Karabiner](https://karabiner-elements.pqrs.org/): A powerful and stable keyboard customizer
- [Hammerspoon](https://www.hammerspoon.org/): macOS automation with Lua scripting
- [Skhd](https://github.com/koekeishiya/skhd): Create keyboard shortcuts
- [Yabai](https://github.com/koekeishiya/yabai): Tiling window management for Mac
- [JankyBorders](https://github.com/FelixKratz/JankyBorders): Highlight the focused window with a border
- [SketchyBar](https://github.com/FelixKratz/SketchyBar): Header status bar
- [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/): Terminal emulator
- [Ghostty](https://ghostty.org/): Alternative terminal emulator
- [Tmux](https://github.com/tmux/tmux/): Terminal multiplexer
- [Fish](https://fishshell.com/): The best shell
- [Fisher](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/fisher): Plugin manager for fish (tide, z, nvm.fish, autopair)
- [Zathura](https://pwmt.org/projects/zathura/): Minimal PDF/DjVu/PS reader with vim bindings
- [Lazygit](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit): Terminal UI for git
- [Sc-im](https://github.com/andmarti1424/sc-im): Use Excel spreadsheet on terminal
- [Mousecape](https://github.com/alexzielenski/Mousecape): A free cursor manager for Mac OS
- [Vimium C](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/vimium-c-all-by-keyboard/hfjbmagddngcpeloejdejnfgbamkjaeg?hl=en): Vim bindings for the browser
- [Surfingkeys](https://github.com/brookhong/Surfingkeys): Scriptable vim bindings for the browser
- [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code): Agentic coding on the terminal
- [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/): Open source AI coding agent

## CLI tools

- [Fzf](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf/): Fuzzy search
- [fd](https://github.com/sharkdp/fd): Better find
- [Ripgrep](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/): Better grep
- [Eza](https://github.com/eza-community/eza): Better ls
- [Bat](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat): Better cat
- [Delta](https://github.com/dandavison/delta): Better git diffs
- [Jq](https://github.com/jqlang/jq): JSON processor, used by several scripts here
- [Btop](https://github.com/aristocratos/btop): Resource monitor
- [Numi-cli](https://github.com/nikolaeu/numi): Calculator on the terminal
- [Cliclick](https://github.com/BlueM/cliclick): Trigger mouse events from the terminal
- [Pngpaste](https://github.com/jcsalterego/pngpaste): Paste images from the clipboard to a file
- [Neofetch](https://github.com/dylanaraps/neofetch): System info on the terminal
- And more.
